**Prioritization:** A shared responsibility, with product management balancing client requests against the core product strategy.
**Shipping:** Managed by the development team, with a focus on maintaining a single, adaptable product version.
**Sales-input:** Integral to product development, particularly for large enterprise deals where sales often drives feature requests.
**Design:** While important, it is secondary to the adaptability and workflow integration required by enterprise clients.

episodes.title: Los Bancos No Nos Quieren con Harold Correa, Fundador de Ikualo

episodes.title: \"Una Lista de Correos NO es una Comunidad\" con David Bonilla, creador \"La Bonilista\"

episodes.title: El BANCO sin SUCURSALES ni CAJEROS | Guido Lonetti, Head of Product de N26

episodes.title: Trabajar PRODUCTO SIN Frameworks | Arnau Romero, Director de Producto de Typeform
episodes.thesis: Typeform ships without worshipping frameworks — founder-led R&D explores bets, then either folds them into the main form product or spins them as separate brands.

episodes.title: El rol del PRODUCT DESIGNER con Cris Busquets, Senior Product Designer en Automattic
episodes.thesis: At Automattic (Jetpack), product designers often own discovery and prioritization themselves — design absorbs classic PM duties under high autonomy.

episodes.title: De TRABAJAR como Product Manager a EMPRENDER con Carlos Horno, Co Founder de Dealcar

episodes.title: \"El evento de PRODUCTO más GRANDE de España\" | Diego Chico de Guzmán, CEO de Thiga España
episodes.thesis: Thiga España treats La Product Conf as positioning infrastructure — credibility and talent magnet first, ticket revenue second; consulting rides the community halo.

episodes.title: \"Empezamos vendiendo ENTRADAS por FAX\" | Manuel Roca, CEO y Cofounder de Atrápalo
episodes.thesis: Atrápalo stayed a multi-vertical leisure marketplace — tickets, travel, restaurants — by chasing demand signals instead of locking into one niche (they literally started selling tickets by fax).

episodes.title: \"Queremos CREAR la siguiente gran COMUNIDAD profesional\" | Cristian García, CPO de Nova Talent
episodes.thesis: Nova Talent builds a premium B2C professional community on top of B2B headhunting — curated horizontal connections are the product bet, not just placements.

episodes.title: ¿Mi TRABAJO será REMPLAZADO por la AI? | Rafa Pulido, Co Founder Capably.ai
episodes.thesis: Capably sells enterprise AI adoption as data prep + governance + ops integration — the product delegates working hours to AI once the company data is ready.

episodes.title: ¿Cómo POSICIONAR mi PRODUCTO en el mercado? | Carlota Güell, PMM de Decathlon
episodes.thesis: Decathlon Outdoor uses the app to reposition from selling gear to enabling outdoor experiences — product marketing owns lifestyle, not only SKU pages.

episodes.title: \"Queremos facturar 60M en 2024\" con Gonzalo Noy, CEO y Co Founder de Dogfy Diet
episodes.thesis: Dogfy Diet bets on cooked, personalized dog meals on subscription — product is humanization of pet food, not kibble SKUs in a pet aisle.

episodes.title: El rol del Product Marketing Manager en Meta con Daniel Núñez, PMM en Meta
episodes.thesis: At Meta, PMMs sit inside product strategy — portfolio narrative and launch packaging are owned with product, not bolted on after the roadmap ships.

episodes.title: \"De Consultoría Industrial a Product Management\" con Álvaro Pérez, Founder y CPO de Clevergy
episodes.thesis: Clevergy sells white-label energy SaaS to utilities and solar installers — product deepens their customer relationships instead of competing for end users.

episodes.title: \"Nuestra North Star es que el cliente repita\" con Adrián de Pedro, CPTO de Shakers

episodes.title: \"Los Product Managers deben ser los líderes de negocio\" con Ramón Castro, CPO de Trucksters
episodes.thesis: At Trucksters, each PM owns one business unit metric end-to-end — product managers are business leaders, not backlog administrators.

episodes.title: \"Enseñar inglés a niños al estilo Netflix\" con Rodrigo Servert, CEO & Fundador de Nominis
episodes.thesis: Nominis teaches kids English like Netflix — interactive stories and gamification replace classroom drills for ages 6–12.

episodes.title: \"La AI se va a quedar\" con Sara Guiral, Senior PM en Hubspot
episodes.thesis: HubSpot mobile ships marketer journeys as fast MVPs — product adapts AI into on-the-go CRM workflows rather than waiting for perfect desktop parity.

episodes.title: De hacer un MVP con Telegram a levantar 60M€ con Javier Escribano
episodes.thesis: OnTrack validated empty-truck logistics with a Telegram MVP first — problem (40% empty km) before process; tools stay ugly until the market answers.

episodes.title: Análisis de Datos para Product Managers con Sara Diez CPO de Tuio
episodes.thesis: Tuio starts data strategy with qualitative insight and whatever spreadsheet already exists — instrument later; early product decisions don’t wait on a perfect warehouse.

episodes.title: Fundar una Startup con 16 años con Alvaro Pintado, Fundador de hello.app
episodes.thesis: hello.app monetizes idle device storage into a decentralized network — users earn by contributing unused capacity instead of renting centralized cloud.

episodes.title: El rol de Product Manager en Shopify con David Garcia, Senior PM de Shopify
episodes.thesis: On Shopify’s Shop app, PMs optimize the buyer side of commerce — checkout, payments, and post-purchase — so merchants win when shopping feels effortless.

episodes.title: ¿Qué es el Product Engineering? con Alvar Montes, Head of Product de Hellotickets
episodes.thesis: Hellotickets runs product engineering: engineers debate strategy in painful grooming sessions and own product context — not just ticket execution for tours/experiences.

episodes.thesis: Pitch competes on collaborative decks with design-system consistency — pricing and product assume presentations are team work, not solo PowerPoint files.

episodes.title: Las claves para ser Product Manager con Ramón Andrío, Head of Product de Cabify
episodes.thesis: Cabify’s B2B wedge is predictable corporate pricing plus full-trip invoicing on the same driver network — sales-led discovery shapes product more than consumer marketplace A/B loops.

episodes.title: El rol de Product Marketing con Isabel Gárate, VP de Producto en Landbot
episodes.thesis: Landbot democratizes conversational automation so non-engineers ship chatbots — product + PMM sell time saved on repetitive customer work.
